data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'farahah' meaning 'to be joyful or to delight'. In Islamic tradition, Farihat represents the joy and happiness that comes from living a virtuous life in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Farihat carries the meaning “Joyful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farihat usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
